info.description: The Event Ticket Seating Information API provides access to detailed seating arrangements for various events within the ticketing system. It allows users to retrieve specific seating data, including availability and layout, essential for customers looking to purchase tickets. This API is particularly useful for ticket vendors, event organizers, and consumers, enabling them to make informed decisions regarding seating options at events. Developers can leverage this API to integrate seating information into ticketing platforms or mobile applications to enhance user experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed seating information associated with purchased tickets. It provides insights into seat availability, location, and other relevant details necessary for managing ticketed events.
